public_payload.normalized_proposition: AI startups other than OpenAI and Anthropic are floundering with negative gross margins.

statement.excerpt: Outside of these two, AI startups are floundering, struggling to stay alive and raising money in several-hundred million dollar bursts as their negative-gross-margin businesses flounder.

from_speaker: raising money in several-hundred million dollar bursts
our_interpretation: The population is generative AI software startups other than OpenAI and Anthropic, following the surrounding software discussion.
This is a broad characterization of the population, not a claim established by selecting a few distressed companies.
Use April through June 2025, the latest completed calendar quarter ordinarily reportable before publication, for the ongoing margin and financial condition.
Negative gross margin means delivery costs exceed revenue. Following the surrounding discussion, delivery costs include serving free users.
Floundering and struggling to stay alive require evidence of financial distress or inadequate runway. A large financing round alone does not establish distress.
The contextual margin examples cite press reporting, so the accounting basis is treated as estimate rather than GAAP.
criteria.support_condition: Representative, consistently measured accounts show negative gross margins and financial distress across the stated startup population, with funding disclosures corroborating the described financing pattern.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative evidence shows the population generally has positive gross margins and adequate financial health. Isolated positive or negative examples alone do not settle this broad characterization.
